name: reasoning-skills
description: Reasoning-domain skills. One so far: proof-decomposer (decompose, design, and grade a deductive argument or math proof on the ARGUMENT x VERIFICATION axes — are the steps valid AND do they prove the stated claim, not a subtly different one — scored separately, with a proof-structure checker that catches circular reasoning, dangling citations, and unreachable goals, plus a numeric counterexample search). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
